description: This file defines the MessageAttachment struct and related methods for handling message attachments in Mattermost, including validation, equality checks, and parsing Slack links to Markdown.

classes.name: MessageAttachment
classes.description: Represents a message attachment with various fields such as title, text, author info, images, and actions.

classes.name: MessageAttachmentField
classes.description: Represents a field within a message attachment, including title, value, and display options.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the MessageAttachment object, checking URL formats, color styles, and timestamp type.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Compares two MessageAttachment objects for equality.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the MessageAttachmentField object, ensuring value is string or int.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality of two MessageAttachmentField objects.

methods.name: StringifyMessageAttachmentFieldValue
methods.description: Converts the values of attachment fields to strings.

methods.name: ParseMessageAttachment
methods.description: Parses and processes message attachments, converting Slack links to Markdown.

methods.name: ParseSlackLinksToMarkdown
methods.description: Replaces Slack link syntax with Markdown link syntax in text.
